Sort by Name (default, Folder first checked)
Compare the order of Indent.md / Indent2.md and Regex.md / Regex2.md

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After typing text into a new empty document, Undo becomes enabled and reverts the typing
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Undo and Redo stay greyed out/disabled after typing "hello" then " world" in a newly created empty file (Save becomes enabled), so edits can't be stepped back. In files that already had content, Undo worked.
steps: Enter title 'qa', keep Markdown / Empty file, tap OK
Type 'hello' in the empty editor, then ' world'
Observe the Undo button in the toolbar: greyed out and can't be used

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Undo is enabled after typing in an empty document, and tapping it reverts the typing
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In a document that was empty when opened, Undo/Redo stay disabled while typing; tapping Undo does nothing and the text "hello world" stays. Save does enable. Reproduced again on a second attempt; files that opened with content undo fine.
steps: Files tab, tap + to create a new file named 'qa' (.md, Empty file), tap OK
Editor opens empty with Undo/Redo disabled
Tap the editor and type 'hello', then ' world'
Tap Undo in the toolbar: it remains disabled and the text is unchanged

sign_off.notes: I filed one bug, which the developer confirmed. In a file that was empty when opened (new qa.md), Undo and Redo stay disabled after typing, and tapping Undo does nothing. I filed a second report on name sort order (Indent2.md listed before Indent.md, Regex2.md before Regex.md). The developer could not reproduce it, so I treated it as expected. Checked and no defects found: sort options including reverse, file selection and favourite marks, search and replace (literal, regex, replace-all, replace-one), undo in files with content, list toggle on Indent.md, view mode including a table, and rotation in view mode. Not tested: Date, Size and MIME sorts, Folder local, .dotfiles, and Single.md without a trailing newline. I left a test file, qa.md, in the notebook folder.
